verses: Noon, qasam hai qalam ki aur uss ki jo kuch kay woh (farishtay) likhtay hain
To apney rab kay fazal say deewana nahi hai
Aur bey shak teray liye bey inteha ajar hai
Aur be-shak to boht baray (umdah) ikhlaq per hai
Pus abb to bhi dekh ley ga aur yeh bhi dekh len gay
Kay tum mein say kaun fitna mein para hua hai
Be-shak tera rab apni raah say behakney walon ko khoob janta hai, aur woh raah yafta logon ko bhi bakhoobi janta hai
Pus to jhutlanay walon ki na maan
Woh to chahatay hain kay to zara dheela ho to yeh bhi dheelay parr jayen
Aur to kissi aisay shakhs ka bhi kaha na manna jo ziyadah qasmen khaney wala
Bey beywaqar, qammena, aib go, chughalkhor khor
Bhalaee say rokney wala hadd say barh janey wala gunehgar
Gardan kash phir sath hi bey nasab ho
Uss ki sirkashi sirf uss liye hai kay woh maal wala aur beton wala hai
Jab uss kay samney humari aayaten parhi jati hain to keh deta hai kay yeh to aglon kay qissay hain
Hum bhi uss ki soond (naak) per daagh den gay
Be-shak hum ney unhen ussi tarah aazma liya jiss tarah hum ney baagh walon ko aazmaya tha jabkay unhon ney qasmen khayen kay subha hotay hi uss baagh kay phal utaar len gay
Aur inshaallah na kaha
Pus uss per teray rab ki janib say aik bula charon taraf ghoom gaee aur yeh so hi rahey thay
Pus woh baagh aisa ho gaya jaisay kati hui kheti
Abb subha hotay hi unhon ney aik doosray ko aawazen den
Kay agar tumhen phal utarnay hain to apni kheti per saweray hi saweray chal paro
Phir yeh sab chupkay chupkay yeh baaten kertay huye chalay
Kay aaj kay din koi miskeen tumharay pass na aaney paye
Aur lapkay huye subha subha gaye. (samajh rahey thay) kay hum qaboo paagaye
Jab unhon ney baagh dekha to kehney lagay yaqeenan hum raasta bhool gaye
Nahi nahi balkay)yeh humari qismat phoot gaee
Unn sab mein jo behtar tha uss ney kaha kay mein tum say na kehta tha kay tum Allah ki pakeezgi kiyon nahi biyan kertay?
To sab kehney lagay humara rab pak hai be-shak hum hi zalim thay
Phir woh aik doosray ki taraf rukh ker kay aapas mein malamat kerney lagay
Kehney lagay haaye afsos! yaqeenan hum sirkash thay
Kiya ajab hai kay humara rab humen uss say behtar badla dey dey hum to abb apney rab say hi aarzoo rakhtay hain
Yun hi aafat aati hai aur aakhirat ki aafat boht bari hai. Kaash unhen samajh hoti
Perhezgaron kay liye unn kay rab kay pass nematon wali jannaten hain
Kiya hum musalmanon ko misil gunah gaaron kay ker den gay
Tumhen kiya hogaya, kaisay faislay ker rahey ho?
Kiya tumharay pass koi kitab hai jiss mein tum parhtay ho?
Kay uss mein tumhari mann mani baaten hun?
Ya tum ney hum say kuch qasmen li hain? Jo qayamat tak baqi rahen kay tumharay liye woh sab hai jo tum apni taraf say muqarrar ker lo
Unn say poocho to kay unn mein say kaun uss baat ka zimeydaar (aur daaweydaar) hai?
Kiya unn kay koi shareek hain? To chahaiye kay apney apney shareekon ko ley aayen agar yeh sachay hain
Jiss din pindli khol di jaye gi aur sajday kay liye bulaye jayen gay to (sajdah) na ker saken gay
Nigahen neechi hun gi aur unn per zillat o khuwari rahi hogi, halankay yeh sajday kay liye (uss waqt bhi) bulaye jatay thay jab kay sahih saalim thay
Pus mujhay aur uss kalaam ko jhutlanay walay ko chor dey hum unhen uss tarah aahista aahista khenchen gay kay unhen maloom bhi na hoga
Aur mein unhen dheel doon ga, be-shak meri tadbeer bari mazboot hai
Kiya to unn say koi ujrat chahata hai jiss kay tawaan say yeh dabay jatay hain
Ya kiya unn kay pass ilm ghaib hai jissay woh likhtay hun
Pus to apney rab kay hukum ka sabar say (intizar ker) aur machli walay ki tarah na ho jaa jab kay uss ney ghum ki halat mein dua ki
Agar ussay uss kay rab ki nemat na paaleti to yaqeenan woh buray halon mein chatyal maidan mein daal diya jata
Ussay uss kay rab ney phir nawaza aur ussay nek kaaron mein ker diya
Aur qareeb hai kay kafir apni tez nigahon say aap ko phusla den, jab kabhi Quran suntay hain aur keh detay hain yeh to zaroor deewana hai
Dar haqeeqat yeh (Quran) to tamam jahaan walon kay liye sirasir naseehat hi hai
